_source: Designers, screenshot of the PowerPoint colour gallery, 2026-09-22. Ten colours, given left to right as the first row of «Цвета темы» must read.
_gallery_order: PowerPoint lays that row out as lt1, dk1, lt2, dk2, accent1…accent6 (the master's clrMap: bg1=lt1, tx1=dk1, bg2=lt2, tx2=dk2). The designers' order is mapped onto the slots here; the file below is in the order the OOXML schema requires, which is a different one.
_not_the_slide_palette: Nothing on a slide reads these. Shapes are painted with direct srgbClr from assets/base.css and no schemeClr reference exists in the code, so changing this file changes the colour gallery in PowerPoint and the objects a reader adds by hand — not the deck. The brand yellow here is FFDD2D, matching the slides. The earlier FFDD2C in this slot was a typo in the designers' list (2026-09-22); they confirmed it was an error and it has been corrected.
_hlink: hlink and folHlink were not supplied. Office defaults are kept: a link colour is not a brand decision anyone has made, and a scheme has to carry all twelve slots.
